rule: Instinct is permanent, the standard-delivery fallback, asked for, planned, gated on one commit, and wave delegations stay safe
description: P3 coupling inside plugin/agents/overlord.md. The source pins Instinct as a permanent delivery path that is also the engine's standard-delivery fallback (ADR-0039 decision 2). The consumers pin the key rules of `## Engine`, `## Instinct` and `## Parallel Delegation Safety` on their key terms: the engine launches standard-delivery only when `## Instinct` picks it; a refused or blocked launch, or a started run that fails or ends blocked, continues on Instinct (decisions 3 and 4); uncommitted edits a failed run left stop the takeover and are never discarded; Instinct never relaunches the engine; a request naming neither path takes the engine with a working_branch.base ref and otherwise asks the user, with a recommendation; a plan comes before any edit; the PR opens only on a commit validation and local review both passed on, and a later commit reruns both; and each wave delegation must forbid git writes and repo-global mutations. tests/workflow-scripts/overlord-contract.test.mjs pins the rest of the fallback sentences. Pins claim word sequences only, never meaning: a contradicting rewrite elsewhere in the file stays green.

source.pattern: Instinct, a permanent delivery path beside the script engine, is also its `standard-delivery` fallback

consumers.pattern: For `standard-delivery`, launch only when `## Instinct` picks the engine
If a `standard-delivery` launch is refused or blocked (denied, not found, or workflows turned off), or the started run fails or ends blocked, say so in one line and continue on Instinct
Uncommitted edits the failed run left stop the takeover per `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/definitions.md` (Unsafe Git State) and are never discarded
A `standard-delivery` request that names neither path takes the engine when it carries a `working_branch.base` ref
otherwise ask the user which, with your recommendation
Every run needs a plan before any edit
the PR by `hivemind:open-plan-pr` only on a commit that validation and local review (unless the Codex plugin is unavailable or the request skips it) both passed on
Each wave delegation must forbid git writes
Each wave delegation must forbid repo-global mutations
